services.desc: Western Washington bass fishing continues to grow in popularity-and for good reason! Not only does our region offer easy access to scenic lakes, but it’s also home to some of the biggest Smallmouth in the country. In fact, it’s not uncommon to hook into a trophy-sized 5-pounder during a single outing. Because Washington has such a diverse and healthy fishery, anglers from all over the nation come here to chase both largemouth and smallmouth. While you may have a specific lake in mind, we often recommend your destination based on current catch rates, seasonal trends, and recent productivity.
